name: Since the End
source:
The day a young man was pulled into the underground forced to chose protecting the only family he has or risking everything for a livable wage. 

[From [url=https://ghostleif.itch.io/since-the-end]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一天，一名年轻人被拉入地下，被迫选择保护他唯一的家庭，还是冒着一切风险换取一份足以维持生计的工资。

[来自[url=https://ghostleif.itch.io/since-the-end]itch.io[/url]]
